title: Digital Banking Platform
description: A modern core banking system for a digital-first bank. Supports account management, transactions, and interest calculations.

modules.name: Ledger System
modules.description: Immutable, append-only ledger for all financial transactions.

modules.name: Account Management
modules.description: Creation and management of checking, savings, and credit accounts.

modules.name: Payment Gateway
modules.description: Integration for ACH, Wire transfers, and domestic instant payments.

modules.name: Fraud Detection
modules.description: Rule-based engine to flag suspicious transactions in real-time.

learning_outcomes: Building distributed, highly consistent financial systems

title: Cryptocurrency Exchange
description: A secure cryptocurrency trading platform featuring real-time order matching, wallet management, and market data websockets.

modules.name: Order Matching Engine
modules.description: High-performance engine to match buy and sell orders based on price and time.

modules.name: Wallet Service
modules.description: Secure generation and management of crypto addresses and balances.

modules.name: Market Data Feeds
modules.description: Real-time price tickers and order book updates via WebSockets.

modules.name: KYC/AML Portal
modules.description: User verification flow integrating with identity verification APIs.

title: Automated Investment Advisor (Robo-Advisor)
description: A platform that automatically manages customer investment portfolios based on their risk profile and market conditions.

modules.name: Risk Profiler
modules.description: Questionnaire and algorithm to determine user's risk tolerance.

modules.name: Portfolio Rebalancing
modules.description: Automated buying/selling to maintain target asset allocations.

modules.name: Market Data Ingestion
modules.description: Daily fetching of ETF and stock prices from financial APIs.

modules.name: Performance Reporting
modules.description: Generating monthly statements and performance charts.

title: Peer-to-Peer Lending Platform
description: A marketplace connecting borrowers with individual investors, including credit scoring and loan servicing features.

modules.name: Credit Assessment
modules.description: Evaluating borrower risk using external credit bureau data.

modules.name: Loan Marketplace
modules.description: Listing approved loans for investors to browse and fund.

modules.name: Repayment Scheduler
modules.description: Calculating EMI schedules and processing monthly repayments.

modules.name: Secondary Market
modules.description: Allowing investors to sell their loan parts to other investors.

project_objectives: Automate monthly repayment collection and distribution

title: Corporate Expense Management App
description: A platform for companies to manage employee expenses, issue virtual cards, and automate receipt OCR processing.

modules.name: Virtual Card Issuance
modules.description: Integration with card networks to generate virtual credit cards for employees.

modules.name: Receipt OCR
modules.description: Using ML to automatically extract merchant, amount, and date from receipt images.

modules.name: Approval Workflows
modules.description: Customizable multi-level approval chains based on expense amounts and departments.

modules.name: Accounting Sync
modules.description: Exporting categorized expenses to Xero or QuickBooks.
